author: Inside Edition
description: Juliana Peres Magalhaes was sentenced to 10 years in prison for manslaughter in connection with the shooting death of a stranger who had been lured to the house in an effort to frame him for Christine Banfield's death.
title: Nanny Sentenced In Affair/Homicide Case #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: These people had regrettable tattoos. In 2019, Ariana Grande learned that some mistakes are harder to change after a tattoo faux pas. In 2022, former gang member David Loya turned his life around, and getting tattoos removed played a part in his transition. In 2022, after Kanye West made several controversial comments, his fans worked quickly to get tattoos of the rapper removed. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more.
title: Would You Get These Regrettable Tattoos Removed?

author: Inside Edition
description: A boat carrying a family of six raced through the ocean as onlookers wondered what the boat was doing. The boat suddenly got caught up in a large wave and the boat capsized. The family fell into the ocean. Local Santa Cruz resident Vince Tuzzi recorded the crash. In an impressive response, at least eight surfers paddled out to save the family. Inside Edition's Les Trent spoke to two of the hero surfers, 14-year-old Ian Anderson and 14-year-old Emilio Puhvel.
title: Hero Surfers Rescue Family After Their Boat Capsizes
